title: Brake inspection
purpose: The inspection every brake complaint starts with.
facts: Catalogue job brake_inspection: menu 49.95, 0.5 h; wheels off, measurements in mm, hoses, slides, fluid, road test, photos.
Thin pads seen during the courtesy inspection carry no inspection charge.
S7: the customer's first visit began with this job.

list_items.item: If the car is already in for a service and the technician sees thin pads through the wheel, that is the free courtesy inspection doing its job. There is no inspection charge for that.
The fee is not taken off the repair. Why.
Grinding, a pedal that sinks, or a brake warning light: tell the customer not to drive it far, and offer the tow.
